newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Human approves medium-term business plan.
newsitem.headline: Human approves medium-term business plan.

text.p: The management of Hungary's Human Rt approved the medium-term business plan of the pharmaceuticals company, Human said in a statement.
Details of the plan, running until 1999, were released in the official bourse gazette. The figures are for Human only and exclude its subsidiaries, Rudolf said.
Human forecasts pre-tax profits of 790 million forints, 1.24 billion and 1.53 billion in 1997, 1998 and 1999, respectively, it said.
Meanwhile its total sales for the three years are seen rising to 9.2 billion, 12.95 billion and 15 billion forints.
These figures compare to an expected pre-tax profit of 660 million on sales of 9.66 billion in 1996 and a pre-tax profit of 494 million on sales of 10.49 billion in 1995.

Human's revenues from its own activities are forecast to rise to 7.55 billion forints in 1997, to 11.1 billion in 1998 and to 12.95 billion in 1999, from 6.66 billion in 1996 and 5.48 billion last year.
